full_description:
Main speed-density (vacuum based) base fuel map for cylinder 1 while in gear with the clutch released. Output is a raw fuel quantity (injection time units) indexed by manifold vacuum and RPM.

HOW THE ECU USES IT: Code: FUN_45320 looks up all six maps of the cylinder 1 set (pointer table 0x16BDF4, index cyl*6+n); FUN_453B8 then uses map 1 as the result, blended with map 2 by a weight that is hard-coded to 0, so this map is the one that actually fuels cylinder 1. In neutral / clutch-in the "IAP - Neutral/Clutch-In | Cyl 1" map is used instead. Was "IAP - Mode A | Gear 1" in the DanCycles naming.

AXES: X axis: 30 points, 0.00 to 78.1 vacuum kPa; Y axis: 50 points, 800 to 16000 RPM.

VALUES (stock 5JCZSJ40): 532 to 4872 raw (inj. time?).

TUNING NOTES: This is the cylinder 1 IAP fuel map you would normally tune. Changes here affect cylinder 1 only, so keep the four cylinder maps consistent unless you are correcting a cylinder-to-cylinder imbalance. How the TPS and IAP results are combined downstream has not been traced yet - change one family at a time and log.

CONFIDENCE: Cylinder assignment confirmed from code (cyl*6 indexing) and from data (stock cylinder-to-cylinder offsets match the Neutral/Clutch-In Cyl 1-4 maps exactly in the same order).

Main alpha-N (throttle based) base fuel map for cylinder 1 while in gear with the clutch released. Output is a raw fuel quantity (injection time units) indexed by throttle angle and RPM.

HOW THE ECU USES IT: Code: FUN_4536c looks up all six maps of the cylinder 1 set (pointer table 0x17EBE4, index cyl*6+n); FUN_453B8 then uses map 1 as the result, blended with map 2 by a weight that is hard-coded to 0, so this map is the one that actually fuels cylinder 1. In neutral / clutch-in the "TPS - Neutral/Clutch-In | Cyl 1" map is used instead. Was "TPS - Mode A | Gear 1" in the DanCycles naming.

AXES: X axis: 26 points, 0.46 to 118 deg (abs. TP angle); Y axis: 50 points, 800 to 16000 RPM.

VALUES (stock 5JCZSJ40): 467 to 5351 raw (inj. time?).

TUNING NOTES: This is the cylinder 1 TPS fuel map you would normally tune. Changes here affect cylinder 1 only, so keep the four cylinder maps consistent unless you are correcting a cylinder-to-cylinder imbalance. How the TPS and IAP results are combined downstream has not been traced yet - change one family at a time and log.

CONFIDENCE: Cylinder assignment confirmed from code (cyl*6 indexing) and from data (stock cylinder-to-cylinder offsets match the Neutral/Clutch-In Cyl 1-4 maps exactly in the same order).

REFERENCE: data @0x16EF28, X axis @0x1563A4, Y axis @0x16EEC4, descriptor @0x1563D8, code FUN_4536c.

full_description:
TPS base fuel map for cylinder 1 used while in NEUTRAL or with the CLUTCH PULLED (free-revving, blips, warm-up idle).

HOW THE ECU USES IT: FUN_454DA uses this map when flag 0xFEF0271D bit0 (gear = neutral OR clutch switch on) has been set for at least 3 cycles (counter >= 0x182703 = 3) and option 0x1826E8 != 3; otherwise it passes the in-gear result through.

AXES: X axis: 26 points, 0.46 to 118 deg (abs. TP angle); Y axis: 50 points, 800 to 16000 RPM.

VALUES (stock 5JCZSJ40): 467 to 5351 raw (inj. time?).

TUNING NOTES: Tune for idle quality and free-rev response. Has no effect when riding in gear with the clutch out.

CONFIDENCE: Confirmed from code.

REFERENCE: data @0x17ECA8, X axis @0x156B24, Y axis @0x17EC44, descriptor @0x156B58, code FUN_454da.
